meta.title: NINJA CROSSFIT — go beyond your limits
meta.description: NINJA CROSSFIT — functional training, strength, endurance and daily progress. Choose your goal and book a workout.
meta.ogDescription: Strength begins with a decision. Functional training with NINJA CROSSFIT.

hero.description: It does not matter where you start. What matters is what you are ready to do for your goal. Build strength, endurance and character.
hero.side: NO LIMITS. NO EXCUSES. JUST WORK.

about.label: 01 / WHO WE ARE
about.caption: MORE THAN A GYM. A MINDSET.
about.lead: Ninja CrossFit is where you challenge the person you were yesterday.
about.description: We combine strength work, functional movement and endurance training. Everyone moves at their own pace, united by one philosophy — keep moving forward.

self.title: WORK ON YOURSELF
self.text: Every workout is another step toward your goal.

body.title: TRAIN YOUR WHOLE BODY
body.text: Strength, coordination and endurance in one system.

rhythm.title: FIND YOUR RHYTHM
rhythm.text: Choose the days that work for you and move with confidence.

programs.label: 02 / YOUR GOAL
programs.caption: CHOOSE YOUR DIRECTION
programs.intro: Everyone starts somewhere. We will help you take the next step toward lightness, strength and confidence.

weight.label: FITNESS AND ENDURANCE
weight.title: LOSE WEIGHT
weight.description: Move more, build endurance and work toward your best shape.

mass.label: STRENGTH AND PROGRESS
mass.description: Develop strength and build muscle with a consistent system.

programs.footnote: // Your program and workload are tailored to your fitness level and wellbeing.

coach.label: 03 / YOUR MENTOR
coach.caption: TRAIN WITH YOUR GOAL IN FOCUS
coach.lead: A big goal begins with the right movement. Come train, improve your technique and become stronger step by step.
coach.galleryAria: Photos of the coach during training

apply.title: SEND A REQUEST
apply.text: Tell us your name, phone number and the goal you want to reach.

days.title: CHOOSE YOUR DAYS
days.text: Select the days of the week that work best for you.

start.title: STEP UP TO THE LINE
start.text: Contact us, confirm the details and come to your workout.

location.label: 05 / LOCATION
location.caption: FIND US AND COME TRAIN
location.intro: We train at Mamont Fit — a convenient spot for everyone ready to grow stronger. Choose your map and build a route.
location.description: Open the map, plan your route and arrive a little before your first workout.

apply.label: 06 / JOIN US
apply.intro: The best time to begin is now. Leave your details, choose your goal and preferred days.
